item.title: Olympus
item.description:
A New Addition

My new Olympus OM-1

I bit the bullet on an Olympus OM-1 this week. I snagged it from District Camera after some prodding from Goose and it’s a purchase I don’t think I’ll soon regret. I’m eager to get shooting with it, and I keep think of places I could go that might be good studies for a roll of film.

When Zoe and I went to Japan last year, I took photos on a Leica ZX-2. As you can see from the photos below, the quality you get out of that simple point and shoot runs the gamut.

item.title: Introducing The Calegraph
item.description:
Welcome!

This is the start of my new blog where I’ll be practicing GitHub pages site development, sharing my favorite photos that I’ve taken lately, and generally using as a place to muse on my life and what I’ve been watching, reading, and eating. I hope it’s fun to read for anyone who encounters it!

For now this blog will be named “The Calegraph.” If you used to read my sandwich blog, or are interested on my thoughts on sandwiches in DC, check out the link below. I’m sure there will be more sandwich talk here.
